top_signals.title: Einride, EASE begin daily driverless freight runs in Ohio
top_signals.summary:
Einride has two cabless electric trucks running daily for EASE Logistics in Ohio, a test case for whether autonomy can absorb unplanned short-haul freight.

The post Einride, EASE begin daily driverless freight runs in Ohio appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Bolsonaro Surge in Brazil Opens Door to Commodities Trade Shift
top_signals.summary: A surprising first round in Brazil’s presidential election is raising the prospect of a recalibration in trade policy, with a possible Flávio Bolsonaro government likely to deepen ties with Washington while preserving much of the country’s push to diversify markets.

top_signals.title: Meta may ditch the idea of a cloud business for Muse. We think that’s a good trade
top_signals.summary: We may never get the Meta Cloud business we once envisioned, but we don't need it if Muse delivers.
